cartridges.name: ash

options.name: data_layer
options.doc: Comma-separated, as the site's checkboxes — a resource picks its own: `postgres` (default), `sqlite`, `csv` (`ash_postgres`, `ash_sqlite`, `ash_csv`); `none`, alone, for no data layer.

choices.doc: ash_postgres · The swiss army knife of databases. Versatile, powerful, and battle-tested.
ash_sqlite · Small, fast, and reliable. Perfect for lightweight apps or getting started quickly.
ash_csv · Back resources with CSV files.
no data layer — alone

options.name: api
options.doc: Comma-separated: `json_api`, `graphql`, `typescript` (`ash_json_api`, `ash_graphql`, `ash_typescript`).

choices.doc: ash_json_api · Easily create a spec-compliant JSON:API, directly from your resources.
ash_graphql · Create a powerful and flexible GraphQL API directly from your resources.
ash_typescript · Automatic TypeScript type generation for Ash resources and actions.

options.name: auth
options.doc: Comma-separated authentication strategies: `ash_authentication` and `ash_authentication_phoenix`, handed `--auth-strategy`. One of `password`, `magic_link`, `api_key`, `otp`, `totp`, `github`, `google`, `auth0`, `oauth2`, `oidc`, … (the list is the installer's).

choices.doc: Allow users to log in with email & password.
Send users a link in their email to sign in and register.
Generate and authenticate with API keys.
one of the site's premade OAuth2 configurations
one of the site's premade OAuth2 configurations
one of the site's premade OAuth2 configurations
one of the site's premade OAuth2 configurations
one of the site's premade OAuth2 configurations
one of the site's premade OAuth2 configurations
Sign in using an external service.

options.name: with
options.doc: Comma-separated further packages, as the site's *Advanced Options*: tidewave, ash_ai, usage_rules, ash_money, ash_double_entry, ash_oban, ash_state_machine, ash_events, ash_archival, ash_paper_trail, ash_cloak, live_debugger, ash_admin, mishka_chelekom, cinder. Any package with an Igniter installer works.

values.doc: Speed up development with AI assistants that understand your web application, how it runs, and what it delivers.
First class support for a wide array of LLM tools.
A data type for representing money $$$$.
Moving money around? Need to track financial data?
Oban is a background job system backed by your own SQL database packed with enterprise grade features, real-time monitoring with Oban Web, and complex workflow management with Oban Pro.
Model complex workflows backed by your resource's persistence and actions.
Tracks and persists events when actions are performed on your resources, providing a complete audit trail and event replay.
A lightweight extension to ensure that data is only ever soft deleted.
Automatically track all changes to your resources. Track who did what and when.
Easily encrypt and decrypt your attributes.
A tool for debugging LiveView applications in development.
Mishka Chelekom is a library offering various templates for components in Phoenix and Phoenix LiveView.
A powerful data collection component for Ash resources in Phoenix LiveView.
